item.title: A Post With an Image
item.description:
This post shows how to add images in Hugo with PaperMod.

Cover image

The image at the top is set in the front matter with cover. You can use a path under static/ (e.g. /images/photo.jpg) or an external URL.

Image in the body

You can also embed images in the content with standard Markdown:

Place image files in your site’s static/images/ folder, then reference them as /images/filename.ext. For a hero/cover image, set cover in the post’s front matter as in this post.
